bodySystem: Carried over from the knowledge base

conditions.name: Hip strain

ratingSchedule.note: Hip/thigh residual framework. Evaluate documented residuals under the applicable hip and thigh criteria, including DCs 5250-5255 as appropriate; no single hip-strain-specific diagnostic code is assigned.

reviewNotes: Wave 8 resolves the prior empty rating citation with the current hip/thigh framework rather than inventing a strain-specific diagnostic code. Rating authority describes evaluation only and is not clinical nexus evidence.

conditions.name: Ankle strain

ratingSchedule.note: Ankle residual framework. Evaluate documented residuals under the applicable ankle criteria, including DC 5271 for limited motion when supported by the record; no single ankle-strain-specific diagnostic code is assigned.

reviewNotes: Wave 8 resolves the prior empty rating citation with the current ankle framework rather than inventing a strain-specific diagnostic code. Rating authority describes evaluation only and is not clinical nexus evidence.

conditions.name: Contralateral (opposite) knee condition
reviewNotes: Wave 8 explicitly quarantines this legacy relationship/laterality placeholder: it is not a distinct diagnosis and must not be assigned a diagnosis-specific rating code merely to fill catalog debt.
Future modeling should represent laterality as an attribute or relationship and then retire this placeholder without weakening the one-to-one catalog/knowledge-base integrity contract.

conditions.name: Diabetic retinopathy

ratingSchedule.note: DC 6040 expressly lists diabetic retinopathy under the eye rating schedule; evaluation follows the applicable eye criteria for visual impairment or incapacitating episodes.

reviewNotes: Wave 8 replaces the unresolved carryover note with the condition-specific eye rating identity. The rating citation does not establish that diabetes or any other condition caused an individual's retinopathy.

conditions.name: Chronic insomnia

ratingSchedule.note: Mental-disorders rating framework. Chronic sleep impairment appears within the General Rating Formula for Mental Disorders, but this generic catalog entry is not assigned an invented insomnia-specific diagnostic code.

reviewNotes: Wave 8 records the applicable mental-disorders framework while preserving the distinction between an insomnia diagnosis and a sleep-impairment symptom appearing in the general rating formula.

conditions.name: Substance use disorder

ratingSchedule.note: Mental-disorders rating framework. This broad discovery identity spans substance-specific diagnoses and is not assigned a single generic substance-use-disorder diagnostic code.

reviewNotes: Catalog presence and a rating framework do not establish service connection or compensability. Alcohol- and drug-related legal eligibility rules are separate from rating identity and must be evaluated independently.
Clinical relationship authoring must evaluate the specific substance-use diagnosis and pathway rather than treating this discovery grouping as one etiology.
